children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of reissued 2030 and 2036 T-bonds on Tuesday:
BTr rejects all bids for 20 billion to 30 billion pesos worth of reissued 2030 T-bonds
BTr awards 6.032 billion pesos ($96 million), below the 10 billion to 20 billion pesos programme at an average rate of 7.525%
Tenders total 43.6 billion pesos across all tenors
Details on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
